scope.assessment: Basic qualitative sanity check, not a numerical quality score

observations.retained: Bright pedestrians/vehicles from IR and illuminated awning/sign detail from VIS remain visible.
observations.limitation: Pedestrian prominence and scene contrast are attenuated relative to their stronger source views; details appear soft.

observations.retained: The winding dark structure and bridge/railing geometry from IR coexist with visible-image vegetation and background texture.
observations.limitation: Strong dark-light separation is reduced and much of the fused scene is concentrated in mid-gray tones. The AUTO text is already present in the IR input.

observations.retained: The person and walkway geometry remain visible alongside background texture from VIS.
observations.limitation: The bright IR person is less distinct against the background; local contrast and perceived sharpness are reduced.

sanity_check: No obvious wrong scene, black/white collapse, gross geometric displacement, or large newly visible checkerboard artifact observed at contact-sheet scale.
interpretation: Supports a functioning fusion path with visible contrast attenuation. Existing CPU/GPU comparisons do not suggest that device precision explains this degree of visual contrast change. The specific algorithmic cause has not been isolated.
limits: The contact sheet resamples individual images and cannot certify pixel-level registration or subtle artifacts.
Only three of the 21 pairs were visually reviewed here.
No paper/reference fused image or independent quality metric was available.
Do not alter fusion, final activation, normalization, or contrast to improve appearance during compatibility reproduction.
